title: ConjunctionEvent
description: A screened close-approach event between two catalogue objects. Carries a composite risk_score and confidence, never a probability of collision — see root README, 'Why we don't publish a probability of collision'.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this screened event.

tca.description: Time of closest approach, UTC, ISO 8601. The root of the range-rate function found by Brent's method.

miss_distance_km.description: Range between the two objects at TCA, kilometres.

relative_velocity_km_s.description: Magnitude of the relative velocity vector at TCA, km/s.

radial_km.description: Miss distance component along the primary's radial (RTN) axis, kilometres. Signed.

in_track_km.description: Miss distance component along the primary's in-track (RTN) axis, kilometres. Signed.

cross_track_km.description: Miss distance component along the primary's cross-track (RTN) axis, kilometres. Signed.

combined_radius_m.description: Sum of the two objects' assumed hard-body radii, metres.

risk_score.description: Composite risk score in [0, 1]: a weighted function of miss distance, relative velocity, and combined radius, NOT a probability of collision.

risk_tier.description: Discretised risk_score for display and alerting.

confidence.description: Confidence in [0, 1] in the screening result, decaying as the older of the two TLE epochs ages, especially below 500 km where drag dominates.

confidence_note.description: Human-readable explanation of what is degrading confidence for this event, if anything.

max_epoch_age_hours.description: The larger of the two objects' epoch_age_hours at screening time. Primary driver of confidence.

screened_at.description: When this event was produced by the screening job, UTC, ISO 8601.
